finalText:
**Found it: `engine.js` rounds too early.**

It rounded the running total to cents after each coupon, then converted to the cart's currency. Rounding should happen once, at the very end. Those thrown-away fractions of a cent get multiplied by the exchange rate, which is how they grow into a visible cent or two.

That's why most carts look fine. Only percent coupons make sub-cent amounts, and only some rates push the leftover across a rounding line. A flat coupon on its own never trips it.

I removed the two early roundings. All 40 tests pass, 0.09s.
